title: T950 Special Edition FUPS hi-tensile Aluminium Bullbar #25
description: T950 Special Edition FUPS hi-tensile aluminium Bullbar. 100mm one piece main cross pipes passing through drilled uprights for maximum strength, no butt welds. 100mm box uprights shown. Provision for removable Over Size signs. Extra deep main channel. Polished aluminium tow pin surround and provision for recessed number plate. Indicator/daylight running lights mounted in outer box uprights. Driving light mounts fitted to customer requirements. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements. Note the Custom Built curved flashing light mount behind sleeper, cobatct us today for your special 'one-off' project.
